reference: Unchanged original project portrait atlas; creative portraits, not historical photographic likeness

geometry.validation: Actual skin/eye ray intersections, independent outer-lip surface rays and mesh bounds; does not measure likeness or PBR appearance

unitTests.scope: Local regression pass before final crown tessellation and moustache-tail refinement; final merged source must also pass PR CI before publication.

costumeAudit.scope: Finite runtime mesh attributes, index bounds and world transforms across all cast/poses. Visual contact checked separately.

nativeVisualAudit.referenceComparison: 8 actors high/low and four views; same CPU geometry renderer, yaw -25 for both before and after

webglVisualAudit.scope: Manual IAB inspection of all eight high-detail portraits; final Kai moustache, drink contact and representative low-detail poses rechecked after export.

limits: Stylized surface, brows and mesh hair remain simplified relative to the portrait atlas; likeness is a visual judgment, not a geometry-test score.
CPU and neutral Blender images use lighting different from the game WebGL scene.
No photographic pores, microhair or cloth simulation.
Head JS is approximately 32.7 MB; deferred loading and low LOD are retained; slow-network startup and physical-device frame rate were not timed.
